units.source_text: 浮舟住在三条的宅院里寂寞无聊，看看庭中花草，亦觉毫无意趣。

en.t: Ukifune lived lonely and bored in the Sanjo residence, and even when she looked at the flowers and grasses in the garden, she found them utterly uninteresting.

units.source_text: 往来出入的只有口操异样的东国方言的人。

en.t: The only people coming and going were those who spoke in the strange dialect of the eastern provinces.

units.source_text: 庭院中也没有可以赏心悦目的花卉。

en.t: There were no flowers in the garden that could please the eye or comfort the heart.

units.source_text: 她在这枯燥无味的屋子里闷闷不乐地度送晨夕。

en.t: In this dull and cheerless house, she passed her mornings and evenings in melancholy.

units.source_text: 回想二条院中二女公子的模样，这青年女子的心中不胜依恋。

en.t: When she thought back on the two young ladies at the Nijo residence, the young woman was overcome with longing for them.

units.source_text: 那个肆无忌惮的闯入者的模样，此时也浮现到她心头来。

en.t: The image of that brazen intruder also rose into her heart at this time.

units.source_text: 不知道他说些什么，但记得许许多多温存委婉的话。

en.t: She did not know exactly what he had said, but she remembered many gentle and tenderly indirect words.

units.source_text: 那身上的衣香，似乎到现在还留剩着。

en.t: The fragrance of his robes seemed even now to linger there.

units.source_text: 连可怕的情节也都回忆起来。

en.t: Even the frightening details all came back to her memory.

units.source_text: 有一天，母亲派人送一信来，殷勤慰问，挂念殊深。

en.t: One day, her mother sent someone with a letter, asking after her tenderly and showing deep concern.

units.source_text: 浮舟想起母亲如此苦心关怀，而自己却生不逢辰，不觉流下泪来。

en.t: Ukifune thought of how anxiously her mother cared for her, and of how unlucky her own life had been, and before she knew it tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 母亲信中有言：“吾儿独居定多不惯，不知心情何等寂寞？”

en.t: In her letter, her mother wrote, My child, living alone must surely be hard to grow used to; I wonder how lonely your heart must be.

units.source_text: 浮舟的回信中说：“女儿在此并不寂寞，反觉安心。

en.t: In Ukifune's reply, she wrote, Your daughter is not lonely here; on the contrary, I feel at peace.
